eighthArmyBoundary.style: heavy black dashes; label "8th Army Boundary Line" printed vertically alongside, near 3405/3506
eighthArmyBoundary.course: Drawn as straight segments, NOT along hexsides. From the north map edge it runs straight south through the middle of the zigzag between columns 32 and 33 (col 32 west, col 33 east) down to the 3202/3302 latitude; then a straight diagonal south-east from about the left corner of 3302, along/just above the 3302-3303 side, across the upper-right corner of 3303, through the bottom of 3402 and along the 3403-3503 side to the right corner of 3403; then straight south through the middle of the zigzag between columns 34 and 35 (col 34 west, col 35 east) down to 3512; then a short diagonal south-east across the bottom of 3512 / top of 3513 to the 3513/3612/3613 corner; then straight south through the middle of the zigzag between columns 35 and 36 (3513, 3514 west; 3613 east) past the east side of Lago del Matese and off the bottom of the photo.
eighthArmyBoundary.sideTest: Every hex lies at least 89% on one side (largest cut: 3513 has 11% east of the line, 3302 has 10% west).

gustavLine.style: dark red-brown (rust) dashes drawn just inside the line hexes, parallel to their southern hexsides; no label in this photo (the N photo has the same dashes as the Gustav Line)
gustavLine.course: Enters from the west along the south side of 3002, runs east-north-east along the south faces of 3002, 3102, 3201, 3301, 3400 (each marked inside the hex), wraps around the south of Alfedena 3501 (SW, S, SE faces) and ends along the south face of 3600 at the N4 east entry tab (3701). So 3002, 3102, 3201, 3301, 3400, 3501, 3600 are ON the line and the hexes north of them are behind it. 3300, 3400, 3500, 3600, 3501 etc. are in the N4 zone section.

bernhardLine.style: small black dots drawn just inside the line hexes along their east/south faces; label "...RD LINE" (BERNHARD LINE) in spaced serif capitals in 3006/3107
bernhardLine.course: Enters from the west along the south face of 3005, wraps the south of 3106 (SW, S, SE faces), then runs north along the east faces of 3205 (also its S face), 3204, 3203 and 3202, then around the south and east faces of 3302 (S, SE, NE) and ends at the corner 3301/3302/3401 where it meets the Gustav Line dashes.

mapKey.location: NE photo, top right: panel on the off-map margin, x 860-1480, y 130-590; sample hexes drawn pointy-top (rotated from the map grid). Full text: italy-map/map-key.md
mapKey.port: Light grey hex with a strip of medium-blue sea and a wavy coastline on one edge; inside, a small white disc with a dark rim holding a black anchor.
mapKey.clear: Plain, flat, very light grey (almost off-white) hex, no texture.
mapKey.minorRoad: Narrow pale cream line edged on both sides by thin black DASHED lines (like a pale line between two dashed rails).
mapKey.majorRoad: Solid, wider, dark charcoal-grey line with no dashes; on the map it has a thin cream edge on each side.
mapKey.town: Small circle, pale tan/pinkish fill, black outline (about 1/6 of a hex wide); name beside it in mixed case.
mapKey.cityMinor_or_cityMajor: Only ONE city symbol in the key ("City"): a black irregular polygon filled with a dark square grid, inside a hex with a solid WHITE outline; name in bold capitals on the map (BOJANO 3812). No separate major-city symbol is shown.
mapKey.riverMarshHexside: River line on the hexside with a grey-green (sage) marsh wash and a dark tuft along the same hexside (river edged with marsh).
mapKey.minorRiver: Medium-blue line of moderate width (~6-7 px in this photo) with no distinct dark outline, running along hexsides.
mapKey.majorRiver: Thicker blue line (~8-9 px in this photo) with a thin dark-navy outline on both edges, running along hexsides.
mapKey.lake: Solid medium-blue elongated blob with a dark navy outline lying along a hexside (the hexside line is still visible under it).
mapKey.victoryPoint: Red disc with a dark rim and a yellow numeral (e.g. "1").
mapKey.minorAirfield: Plain white horizontal bar with a grey edge (runway strip).
mapKey.majorAirfield: Grey disc with a darker rim holding a white aircraft silhouette seen from above.
mapKey.marsh: Whole hex in a grey-green (sage) wash sprinkled with small teal grass tufts and short dark horizontal dashes.
mapKey.hill: Whole hex in flat khaki / tan (sand-brown).
mapKey.landmark: Small white rectangle with a thin grey border (smaller than the minor-airfield bar); no effect on play.
mapKey.mountainHexside: Darker grey-brown relief shading over the tan hill colour; the hexside is a mountain hexside when this dark band covers it along its whole length, continuing into both hexes. No separate ridge-line symbol.
mapKey.mountainPeak: Small solid black triangle with the height in metres below it ("1577" in the key) and, on the map, the peak name; no effect on play.
mapKey.mountainPass: Two short black curved strokes, roughly parallel, crossing a hexside over the dark shading.

notes: Grid: Italy map has EVEN columns half a hex lower (3302 label y 366 vs 3402 y 435). Label centre is 0.37 hex above the hex centre (Salerno used 0.32; with 0.32 the fitted hex lines sat 7 px below the printed ones).
No marsh, airfield, port or landmark symbols in this photo. VP circles: 3002, 3205, 3303 (all "1").

Mountains: the map shows mountains only as dark relief shading over tan hill; mountainShade=true when >=50% of the hex is dark. Mountain hexsides were measured as the share of points 5-8 px either side of the side (10-90% of its length) inside the dark shading (>=0.85 accepted), then every candidate 0.3-1.0 was checked by eye on side crops.

Roads traced by eye on zoomed tiles and confirmed per hexside on side crops. Major-road network: N4 tab -> 3400 -> Alfedena 3501 -> 3601 junction (branch to N4 east tab) -> Rionero 3602 -> 3603 junction (branch east 3704-3803-3804 -> E3 tab) -> 3604 -> bridge -> 3605 -> 3606 junction: west to Isernia 3507 -> 3406 -> Macchia 3307 -> 3207 -> bridge -> 3107 -> 3006 -> off west; south 3607 -> 3708 -> Carpinone 3709 -> 3710 -> Cantalupo 3711 -> 3811 -> Bojano 3812 -> 3813 -> off south.
Roads leaving the photo: major road 3006 west and 3813 south; minor roads 3012 west (to 2912), 3114 south, 3002 west (town at the photo edge), 3314/3413 at the bottom fold.

Zone sections: the 8th Army Boundary Line splits the photo; everything east of it is the 8th Army zone. White dashed hexside lines divide it into N4 (north), E3, E2, E1 (south). Each east entry tab sits beside hexes of the section with the same name.
Atina is not in this photo (it lies further west).
River text: "Biferno" printed along 3912-4012; a blue italic "o" at 3007's west edge is probably the end of "Volturno".
Region label "MATESE APENNIN..." (spaced capitals) across 3512-3713; lake label "Lago del..." in 3514.
